content:
maddy: quick report — onboarding sampleapp exposed SDK vs REST parity issues. SDK v0.12 was silently retrying 401s and also injects a transform header when mapping camelCase to snake_case. This resulted in duplicate side-effects during token refresh.

sam: can you show a repro?

maddy: minimal: SDK call `client.createCompletion({ model: 'redwood/mini', maxTokens: 100 })` -> SDK sends `max_tokens` and header `x-sdk-transform: true`. If the short-lived token expires, auth middleware tries refresh+retry but races: first retry goes out with empty token, server responds 401, SDK retries again and the backend records two entries.

caroline: two issues: (1) param-name mapping toggles server retry semantics via the header, (2) auth middleware doesn't await refresh before re-invoking.

joel: immediate fixes: stop auto-setting transform header for quickstart paths, make 401 non-retriable by default (opt-in), and fix middleware to await token refresh.

sam: added CI test idea: parity job that compares SDK vs REST responses for representative payloads (snake_case vs camelCase, streaming toggle). Failures block release.

devex-bot: deploy 1771400040: feature-flagged removal of `x-sdk-transform` on quickstart flows to staging.

maddy: filed issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/572 (auth retry race) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/573 (transform header parity).

caroline: I'll patch quickstart docs with a callout about casings and link GH issues. Also will add sampleapp dedupe as a stopgap.

sam: thanks — please drop any other parity oddities here (function-calling shapes, streaming differences).
